projects.title: Cloud-Native Microservice Infrastructure on AWS
projects.summary: Multi-AZ AWS reference architecture for a containerised microservice backend and React frontend.
highlights: Private EC2 instances reachable only through SSM Session Manager, no SSH
ALB with ACM TLS certificate and Route 53 DNS
React on S3 behind CloudFront with Origin Access Control
CloudWatch 4xx/5xx alarms via SNS; secrets in SSM Parameter Store

projects.title: Secure Virtual Desktop Infrastructure on VMware ESXi
projects.summary: Bare-metal remote-desktop platform on VMware ESXi where internal servers never face the internet.
highlights: Seven-server design: domain controller, gateway, broker, session hosts, file server, jumpbox
Dual-NIC gateway is the only controlled entry point
File server on an isolated segment, away from user-facing hosts
Published with SOPs and network diagrams

projects.title: DevOps Intelligence Dashboard
projects.summary: Python pipeline turning version-control and project-management API data into Superset dashboards on Kubernetes.
highlights: Python pipeline consuming version-control and project-management REST APIs
Tracks PR velocity, deployment frequency, sprint burndown and SLA breaches
Superset on Kubernetes with StatefulSet PostgreSQL and Redis

projects.title: DevOps Lab Series
projects.summary: Fifty reproducible Docker labs sized for a 16 GB machine, each turning a platform concept into something to break and fix.
highlights: Redis failover lab: primary loss, promotion and client behaviour
Reverse proxy chain lab: NGINX and HAProxy in front of an application
Runs on a 16 GB laptop with no cloud account

projects.title: DevOps Portfolio Site
projects.summary: This site: technology guides with reproducible deployment steps, alongside projects and career history.
highlights: Each guide explains internals and reproducible deployment
Content driven by JSON data files, separate from presentation
Guides link to official docs and related lab videos
